_comment: Recorded 2026-11-19 from internal/orgserver/sdkapi GET /v1/sdk/prompts/support-reply?label=production (version 3 under production, version 4 under staging). The ETag is the SHA-256 of the exact body bytes the server wrote (compact JSON, no HTML escaping, one trailing newline), so a client compares it, never recomputes it. Header names are as Go canonicalises them; clients must match case-insensitively. Pinned by internal/promptreg TestFetchGolden and internal/orgserver/sdkapi TestPromptFetchFixture; the machine route /api/obs/sdk/prompts serves the same body (contract section 7).
